title: Purple Hammer Warrior
description: A female warrior with dark hair and purple eyes is captured mid-action, dynamically posed while wielding a large purple warhammer crackling with lightning. She wears a white and purple cropped outfit with matching armored boots and wraps, set against a plain dark gray background.
